SAMPLE: An AI model proposes a new antibiotic that clears resistant infections in mice
SAMPLE page, invented for tests and never fetched. Halden Research (SAMPLE) with the Coldwater Institute (SAMPLE). Our model, Halden Design, ranked about 12 million molecules for their chance of killing drug-resistant bacteria. We made and tested 40 of the top molecules. Three of the 40 stopped the growth of drug-resistant bacteria in dishes. The best of these cleared a drug-resistant skin infection in 8 of 10 mice. Antimicrobial resistance is when germs stop responding to the drugs that used to kill them. A first safety trial in people is registered as NCT09999001. No other lab has repeated the tests. DOI 10.1016/ut-sample-0014. Halden Design is a deep learning model.
